probes.title: a figure named by its label; the plot is one group described by the points' count and ranges, each series' relation in words with r, and the highest and lowest named point; a series past the first has its own mark's shape
probes.covers: accessibility (role figure, name label), settings.items, settings.series, settings.point, settings.summary, settings.legend
